name: blink-installer-monorepo
description: Build beautiful HTML/CSS/JS Windows installers. NSIS under the hood, miniblink for rendering.
comment:build: Explicit order, not --workspaces: npm runs workspaces alphabetically, which puts the CLI and core before the packages they import types from, so a clean checkout fails its first build and only succeeds on the second.

scripts.build: npm run build -w blink-installer-ui && npm run build -w blink-installer-runtime && npm run build -w blink-installer-core && npm run build -w blink-installer && npm run build -w blink-installer-maker
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
